title: MOANA The Story of the Wind Sisters | Bedtime Story for Kids
fulltitle: MOANA The Story of the Wind Sisters | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
MOANA The Complete Book folk tale. This bedtime story for kids of all ages is not part of the actual MOANA story but provides cultural backdrop. 

Polynesian culture has many myths and legends about the sea, sky, the seasons and the elements. In this read aloud bedtime story, the four winds and how they came to be are told. Another short folk tale derived from the story of Moana. Read aloud by Grandpa Chaz.

Read along or simple close your eyes and let your imagination transport you back in time to the ancient Pacific islands. 

Folk tales and legends are part of the very fabric of that culture. The Introduction -- The Story of Te Fiti which sets the context for the story of Moana -- is one such tale. The author includes several short folk tales interspersed throughout the book. 

This @Chazstories video is a Disney bedtime story for kids age 12 and under, one of hundreds of Disney bedtime stories for kids I read aloud to my grandkids. Subscribe to my channel if your kids/grandkids love Disney bedtime stories and more.

*A personal message from Chaz:* I'm a 70-year old grandfather of eight grandkids who live far away. I want to be a Mr. Rogers-type positive influence on my grandkids and everyone else. The bedtime stories I choose -- or don't choose -- reflect positive values like:

*Friendship* (Finding Nemo/Dory, Winnie the Pooh)

*Family* (Coco, Jungle Book, Encanto)

*Kindness* (Snow White, Cinderella)

*Love* (Princess stories, Anna and Elsa)

*Loyalty* (Winnie the Pooh characters, Mater)

*Goodness* (Mickey Mouse/Minnie Mouse stories)

*Patience* (Beauty and the Beast, Rabbit)

*Responsibility* (Princess Tiana, Judy Hopps/Zootopia)

*Courage* (Moana, Mulan, Jasmine)

*Honesty* (Pinocchio, Belle)

*Curiosity* (Little Einsteins)

As sleep stories, these are such healthy values for kids to fall asleep to and dream about. At my age there's a lot I can't do anymore. But I can do this.

*My plea:* You help me extend that positive, healthy influence to more and more children/families when you subscribe to this channel. I can't do that without you.
